correctness.rationale: Uniform Dirichlet cyclic spacing model gives E[J], E[U], E[JU] by exact simplex shifts. The strict convexity calculation for log Q (including the n=5 edge case) yields a unique root before 1/3 and monotonicity a unique root after 1/3; compact-uniform expansion and small-epsilon bracketing give the asymptotic root scales. The bundled script independently checks rational identities and finite grids; numerical tests are not substituted for analytic proofs.

value.rationale: For fixed finite n>=5 the same two natural circular-coverage observables exhibit two rigorously classified covariance sign transitions, with distinct algebraic and exponentially narrow length scales. This is not a normalization check, narrow table recomputation or routine constant refinement; it reveals a nonmonotone relation between isolation and effective coverage relevant to random fragment layouts.
